topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe this, of all the things to happen. I find out my essay, the one I poured my heart and soul into for that college app, is now just some generic example floating around out there. Did they even ask? Did they even think about the fact that it's personal, that it's mine? Now who knows how many eyes have seen it, how many people might think they know me just because they read a few lines I wrote. It feels like a violation, like they took something private and made it... public. I don’t know what I’m supposed to do about it, but it’s not sitting well at all.
